## Summary

Describe the preset or the docs change.

## Checklist

- [ ] This preset is original work by me or by presets.dev. I did not copy it from another repository, documentation site, or preset collection.
- [ ] Frontmatter matches the schema in CONTRIBUTING.md, including `license: MIT` and `origin: original`.
- [ ] The `slug` matches the file path, and `id` is not already used.
- [ ] Commits are signed off with `git commit -s` (Developer Certificate of Origin).
- [ ] I tried the preset in the tool listed under `tested_with`.

A docs-only change can say so in the summary and leave the preset boxes unchecked.
